title: Prognostic Value of Baseline Neutrophil-to-Lymphocyte Ratio in Advanced Breast Cancer Patients Treated with Trastuzumab Deruxtecan: A Real-World Study.
snippet: Trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) has redefined the treatment of HER2-positive advanced breast cancer (HER2+ ABC), yet responses remain heterogeneous and accessible biomarkers are lacking. title: Clinical Management and Molecular Landscape of Combined Hepatocellular-Cholangiocarcinoma: A Comprehensive Review.
snippet: Combined hepatocellular-cholangiocarcinoma (cHCC-CCA) is a rare and highly aggressive primary liver cancer.
